node.statement: For every Z in M_n tensor S_P, validated node 1.2.1 supplies the missing bridge ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= ||T_n(Z^dagger dot Z)||-C_prod*e*||Z||^2: it follows from amplified adjointness T_n(Z^dagger)=T_n(Z)^dagger, the product-defect estimate for the factors Z^dagger,Z with all corner indices P, and the ordinary C*-identity in the bounded-operator target.
